title: C-39: a refused login can reconnect and retry
notes: The first password is deliberately wrong; the reconnect button must return to login before the good password is sent.
This keeps reconnect behavior separate from the broader login-to-character-select happy path.

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
the client is told the login failed
the invalid-login dialog is on the screen
the client is admitted after reconnecting
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user
